content: तृणम् [तृह्-नक् हलोपश्च <ls>Uṇ. 5. 8</ls>] .²1 Grass in general; किं जीर्णं तृणमत्ति मानमहतामग्रेसरः केसरी <ls>Bh. 2. 29</ls>. .²2 A blade of grass, reed, straw. .²3 Anything made of straw (as a mat for sitting); often used as a symbol of worthlessness or uselessness; तृणमिव लघुलक्ष्मीर्नैव तानसंरुणद्धि <ls>Bh. 2. 17</ls>; see तृणीकृ also.
